lecture: Durations in seconds. Medians and quantiles cover picture shots (value S, R, M or L noted by eye), excluding blacks, title cards, logos and stage shots. 'observe' = measured, with its count; 'convention' = a choice made by the skill, not measured.

position.compte: 6 out of 6 trailers; 7 out of 8 with usage films

durees.unite: s, picture shots of the 6 trailers; start, middle, end = thirds of the duration
durees.acceleration: last third faster than the first: 6 out of 6; strictly decreasing (start > middle > end): 4 out of 6

transitions.fondu_enchaine_place: 6 out of 8 are the move from a title to the picture (a single film); dissolves are a lower bound (detection)
transitions.fondu_depuis_noir_place: the final logo or title comes out of black: 4 out of 6; the closing line (button) comes out of black: 4 out of 4

noir.longs_1s_et_plus: 6, all in the 2 trailers for a work: 1 at the opening, 3 between chapters (16, 20, 42 %), 1 before the closing (84 %), 1 after the title
noir.pulsation_image_noir: 1 trailer out of 6 (7 blacks of 0.2 to 0.9 s between 79 and 84 %); 1 usage film out of 2 (49 blacks of 0.1 to 0.6 s over the whole film)

raccords.echantillon: 16 consecutive cuts in the middle of each film (8 + 8 passes through black for v4-04)
raccords.graphique: 12 out of 120 (color or position carried over; 6 in the game preview)
raccords.personne_puis_produit: 8 out of 8 straight cuts in the wrist usage film

valeurs_plan.compte: 6 trailers, 384 shots; the share of wide shots drops from the first to the last third in 6 films out of 6

mouvement.plans_fixes: 29 out of 384 (7.6 %) in trailers; 3 out of 117 in usage films
mouvement.image_tres_mobile: 53 out of 384, 47 of them in the middle and last thirds
mouvement.mesure: movement = picture difference per second (camera and subject mixed); static < 10 (corpus convention)

mention_initiale.compte: 2 out of 2 trailers for a work

titre_ou_logo_final.note: 7 out of 8 between 2.5 and 4.8 s; 7.7 s for a title animated letter by letter

cartons.usage: text only in the last 10 %: 2 out of 2; a sentence (3 to 9 words) then the name

part_dans_le_pic.compte: less speech in the peak than over the film: 4 out of 5

parole.derniere_replique: between 83 and 94 % of the duration: 5 out of 5

usage.voix_off: 1 film out of 2: 18 sentences, median 2.17 s, 45 % of the time, silent during the peak
usage.sans_voix: 1 film out of 2 (music and sound effects)

image.format: fiction in wide format 2.0 to 2.39:1: 4 out of 4 measurable; usage and games in full frame 16:9: 3 out of 3
image.noir_et_blanc: 0 out of 8, except 2 archive shots in 1 period trailer

musique.raison: the videos have no sound; only the subtitles mention the music (6 films out of 8)
musique.regle: music alone over the hook, over the final build and under the logo; cuts land on the strong beats during the peak; silence or a clean drop just before the button

structure.contenu: a line within the first seconds, situation images, wide shots
structure.statut: a line from the start: observe 4 out of 5 with speech; highest share of wide shots: 6 out of 6

structure.contenu: catalog: punch words, sentence or logo; work: credits between 29 and 45 %
structure.statut: observe 3 out of 3 catalogs with speech; 2 out of 2 works

structure.contenu: catalog: 4.5 s blocks opened by their title; work: the story told in lines
works and scenes mixed, shortest shots, less speech
black, closing line over 1 or 2 shots, black, title or logo that comes out of black

structure_usage.contenu: black, then a shot that reveals the situation (5.1 s long take or the product's glow)
scenes of 4 to 7 shots: situation, person, product, what the product does; one shot in three shows the product
fast cross-cutting (1 film); the other slows down
a sentence of 3 to 9 words, then the name or the logo

seuils_critique.statut: convention set from what was observed: each threshold reuses a measured median, quantile or bound

sources: shot-by-shot analysis of the corpus (not published)
